Describe the expected behavior and what happened.

Include OS, Python/Codex versions, the command used, and safe error codes.
If helpful, reproduce with a public source or synthetic fixture.

Do not attach `.env`, SQLite, saved private articles, tokens, personal
Discord/Notion IDs, or raw logs. Security issues belong in a private route
described by SECURITY.md.
